pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark regions are irregular polygons with high-contrast edges; lower neck patches exhibit stellate geometries with sharp angular projections, while mid-flank patches show smoother, more elongated pixel gradients at their borders.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: A continuous light-toned lattice with distinct tri-nodal and quad-nodal intersections; pathway thickness is relatively uniform across the neck but narrows significantly as it transitions toward the ventral flank.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: The mane exhibits a high-frequency, low-amplitude jagged silhouette along the cervical spine, characterized by closely spaced vertical pixel spikes against the blurred background.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent dark vertical indentation or notch is visible at the dorsal junction where the lower neck meets the shoulder, creating a localized structural disruption in the patch pattern.
